Biology Doctorate Program Options
Graduate Viewbook: build a personalized viewbook of Biology programs.
PhD Biology
Optional: add a specialization
PhD: with specialization in Biochemistry
PhD: with specialization in Chemical and Environmental Toxicology
Program Requirements
Graduate Calendar: view graduate program requirements, courses, and regulations.
Full-time students normally complete the PhD program requirements in four to five years.
Part-time study is available.
The following requirements must be met in order to complete the program:
Completion of coursework and credit requirements, as laid out in the Graduate Calendar.
Completion of an oral Qualifying Examination (within 18 months of entry into the program).
Presentation of at least one public seminar on the candidate’s thesis research.
Completion of a thesis incorporating the results of original research.
Successful oral defence of the thesis before an examination board.
More Information
Information regarding admissions requirements and specializations can be found on our Admissions page.
